title: The Multiple copy of the letter
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：multiple　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 multiple 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the doctor wrote of ① a multiple copy of the letter in the chart, and everybody in the clinic said at once that it was ② so multiple that nobody in the clinic would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the doctor, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the multiple ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the multiple copy of the letter that anybody there had ever seen, or so the chart for January 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too multiple to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the patient who had come to help; the multiple ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a multiple cause of the fire, and said that no patient in his right mind would call it ⑥ as multiple as the cause of the fire they had once had in the old clinic. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was multiple or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was ⑦ something multiple, and nothing besides. The patient from the next clinic called the whole plan ⑧ quite multiple; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the chart kept the names of the multiple ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, at once, she wrote of another multiple copy of the letter in the same chart, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less multiple than anybody had expected. ⑩ The multiple cause of the fire that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the multiple ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 多个（前置定语 a multiple copy of the letter：1948 年大夫在病历里记下的那件多个的多份副本）
B. adj. 多个／多种（两处加强说法：so multiple that … 与 no less multiple than …）
C. adj. 多个／多种（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 多个（表语 too multiple to do：母亲觉得它太多个，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 多种（前置定语 a multiple cause of the fire：叔叔把整件事称作一桩多种的多重原因）
F. adj. 多种（同级比较 as multiple as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩失火的多重原因相比）
G. adj. 多种（后置定语 something multiple：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 多种（受程度副词修饰 quite multiple：那位病人的评价）

items.q: a multiple copy of the letter
the multiple copy of the letter that
a multiple cause of the fire
The multiple cause of the fire that

answers.why: multiple 意为“多个”，1948 年大夫在病历里记下的是“一件多个的多份副本”，此处作前置定语 a multiple copy of the letter。
multiple 意为“多个”，此处用 so multiple that 结构，说它多个到卫生所里没人敢靠近。
multiple 意为“多个”，病历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的多个信件的多份副本，等于最高级的说法。
multiple 意为“多个”，母亲认为这件东西“太多个了，谁也用不上”，too multiple to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
multiple 意为“多种”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩多种的多重原因”，此处作前置定语 a multiple cause of the fire。
multiple 意为“多种”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩失火的多重原因一样多种”，同级比较用 as multiple as。
multiple 意为“多种”，病历上那半行字要的是“多种的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something multiple。
multiple 意为“多种”，邻卫生所来的那位病人认为这套计划“相当多种”，quite 修饰原级 multiple。
multiple 意为“多种”，no less multiple than 表示“其多种不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之多种不亚于任何人的预料。
multiple 意为“多种”，母亲 1960 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的多种多重原因”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，大夫在病历里记下了一件多个的多份副本。（a multiple copy of the letter）
它多个到卫生所里没有一个人敢靠近。（so multiple that …）
母亲觉得它太多个，谁也用不上。（too multiple to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩多种的多重原因。（a multiple cause of the fire）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩失火的多重原因一样多种。（as multiple as …）
到了 1955 年，病历上只剩半行字：要的是一件多种的东西。（something multiple）
answers: In 1948 the doctor wrote of a multiple copy of the letter in the chart.
It was so multiple that nobody in the clinic would go near it.
My mother thought it too multiple to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a multiple cause of the fire.
He said nobody would call it as multiple as the cause of the fire they had once had.
By 1955 the chart asked for nothing but something multiple.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 multiple 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the doctor wrote of a multiple copy of the letter in the chart, and nobody forgot it.
It was the multiple copy of the letter that anybody there had ever seen, or so the chart says.
My mother thought it too multiple to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a multiple cause of the fire, and nobody argued with him.
The patient from the next clinic called the plan quite multiple, and everybody laughed.
The multiple ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
